name: Derby Days Closing Ceremony
description: Sigma Chi closing ceremony for Derby will take place on G Field. We will announce the winners of Derby Days, have a live band, and food.

name: Sigma Chi Derby Days Day 4: PowderPuff
description: Day 4 of Derby Days will be a powderpuff football game where sororities compete against each other in flag football. There will be food and water available at these games.

name: Sigma Chi Christmas Raffle Tabling
description: We will be tabling in front of Trone for our Christmas raffle.

name: Burgers To Beat Cancer
description: We will be grilling and selling burgers to raise money for the Huntsman Cancer Institute.

name: ADPI x ΣX Fashion Show
description: Alpha Delta Pi and Sigma Chi philanthropy fashion show.

name: Derby Days Field Day
description: Hosting various field day activities such as one leg race, balloon toss, egg walk, tug of war, and sack race. Five dollar admission. All proceeds go to benefiting the Huntsman Cancer Institute
